definition: An Aspen PIMS planning model that optimizes refinery plans across several plants and several periods. Aspen PIMS is AspenTech's refinery and olefins linear programming (LP) planning software, by the vendor's description.
note: Which Aspen PIMS model XPIMS is rests on the decision owner's answer of 2026-10-25 (multi-plant and multi-period). AspenTech's training names XPIMS models, but no AspenTech page read on 2026-10-25 defines them; its courses define multi-period (PPIMS) and multi-plant (MPIMS) models (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: An Aspen PIMS planning model that optimizes a refinery plan across several periods, carrying inventory from one period to the next. Aspen PIMS is AspenTech's refinery and olefins linear programming (LP) planning software, by the vendor's description.

An MPC-built optimization model and application that produces the distribution plan for the prompt month to M+3, across pipelines, marine and inventory. Planners build a base distribution plan in it, reconcile it with the XPIMS refinery plan, update its network constraints, and hand over the final distribution plan. It is also used in the distribution backcast, to evaluate actuals cases and optimization cases.
AspenTech's software for scheduling refinery operations. By the vendor's description, it schedules all key petroleum refinery activities at the same time, in one multi-user environment.
An MPC in-house application used by the Commercial organization. It gets all of its data from RightAngle and is almost a replica of it.

ION's commodities trading and risk management system for liquid hydrocarbon companies, such as refiners and fuel marketers. By the vendor's description, it covers the work from front to back and is strongest in scheduling, logistics and operations.
Profisee's master data management (MDM) platform. By the vendor's description, it cleans, unifies and improves the quality of an enterprise's critical data across its systems.
SAP's business suite. By the vendor's description, it is the next-generation business suite, built on the SAP HANA in-memory platform.
note: The process map's "SAP" is SAP S/4HANA by the decision owner's answer of 2026-10-25. Which edition MPC runs is not stated in the repository, so the definition is at product level (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: Oracle's budgeting and planning software. By the vendor's description, users enter, analyze and report on planning data in it and manage the planning process.
note: That the process map's "Hyperion" is Oracle Hyperion Planning rests on the decision owner accepting Claude's recommendation on 2026-10-25, which Claude said was a guess between Planning, Financial Management and Essbase (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: An MPC-built application that supplies actual data, including actual product prices, used as inputs to the regional backcast.
note: The description says what CargoTracker feeds, not what it is; a fuller one waits for its owners (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: AVEVA's software for real-time operations data. By the vendor's description, industrial operations use it to collect, cleanse, store, enrich and visualize real-time operations data.
Microsoft's application for working together. By the vendor's description, it keeps the tools and files a team works with in one place.
Microsoft's email and calendar application. By the vendor's description, it manages email, calendar, tasks and contacts in one place.
Microsoft's presentation application. By the vendor's description, it creates slideshow presentations.
Microsoft's spreadsheet application. By the vendor's description, it is a spreadsheet application and data analysis tool.
